entities.name: Jace Beleren
entities.description: A planeswalker, traumatized by the New Phyrexian Invasion, who creates the Echoverse in an attempt to remove suffering; the story's villain.

entities.name: Echoverse
entities.description: Jace's alternate multiverse without Eldrazi, Nicol Bolas, and Phyrexians, intended to be free of suffering and to replace the original.

entities.name: Hexhaven
entities.description: A dystopian magical school in a geometrically impossible tower, the Echoverse's version of Strixhaven and the inner sanctum that stabilizes it.

entities.name: Strixhaven
entities.description: The magical school whose alternate-reality version is Hexhaven.

entities.name: Loot
entities.description: A small, fuzzy creature with a map of all reality in his head, freed by Jace.

entities.name: Meditation Realm
entities.description: The realm where Jace's ritual went awry and consumed him and the Realm.

entities.name: Narset
entities.description: A planeswalker who witnessed Jace's ritual in the Meditation Realm.

entities.name: Elspeth
entities.description: A planeswalker who witnessed Jace's ritual in the Meditation Realm.

entities.name: Tam
entities.description: A counterpart to Jace Beleren who is not the same character.

entities.name: New Phyrexian Invasion
entities.description: The invasion whose suffering traumatized Jace.

entities.name: Nicol Bolas
entities.description: A dragon planeswalker absent from Jace's Echoverse.

entities.name: Eldrazi
entities.description: Beings that Jace's Echoverse is designed to be without.

entities.name: Phyrexians
entities.description: Beings that Jace's Echoverse is designed to be without.

events.summary: Traumatized by the suffering of the New Phyrexian Invasion, Jace sets out to right what he saw as wrong with the Multiverse.
events.quote: Having been traumatized by the suffering of the New Phyrexian Invasion , Jace set about to right what he saw as having gone wrong with the Multiverse .

events.summary: Jace frees Loot, who holds a map of all reality in his head.
events.quote: His mysterious plans started with freeing Loot from Maag Taranau .

events.summary: Jace's ritual in the Meditation Realm goes awry, consuming him and the Realm as Narset and Elspeth watch.
events.quote: That map led Jace to the Meditation Realm in Tarkir: Dragonstorm where Narset and Elspeth witnessed Jace conduct a ritual that went awry, consuming both Jace and the Realm.

events.summary: Jace creates the Echoverse, intended to be free of suffering.
events.quote: Jace has created the Echoverse , intended to be free of suffering.

events.summary: Jace uses the dystopian school Hexhaven as the inner sanctum that stabilizes the Echoverse.
events.quote: This inner sanctum is the dystopian school Hexhaven , the Echoverse's version of Strixhaven.

relations.note: creates it to replace the original multiverse
